New York City Local Law 144 Notice

For some roles that may be based in or report to New York City, we use tools that help our recruiting team review and organise applications. 

 

These tools support recruiters by helping screen or rank applications based on job-related criteria. 

All hiring decisions are made by people, not by automated tools. 

In line with New York City Local Law 144, candidates may request information about.

  • The type of tool used
  • The job-related criteria it assesses.

Questions or requests can be sent to: hr@optibus.com
